title: Maturation and Renewal Readiness Tracker - Acme Pharma (Draft)
content:
Purpose:
This working tracker captures the post-pilot maturation path for Acme Pharma's inference deployment with explicit milestones, owners, blocking issues, and renewal-readiness signals. The goal is to give CS, Solutions, and SRE a single living source for the next 90 days to drive to predictable production behavior and a clean renewal conversation.

Scope:
- Tracks technical rollouts (Dedicated + Private config), integration milestones (SAML, VPC peering, KMS), and operational readiness (observability, runbooks, SLO verification).
- Includes renewal-readiness criteria (usage floor, latency SLA, critical blockers resolved).
- Intended audience: CSM, Solutions Eng, SRE/Platform, Account Exec.

How to use this doc:
- Update the "status" and "blockers" after each sync; use last_modified on top-level metadata for major changes.
- When a blocker moves to "owned/mitigated", add the ticket link under linked_artifacts and call out the impact.
- For QBR, extract the "renewal signals" section as a one-page summary.

Summary snapshot (as of 2026-03-08):
- Overall health: Yellow (some integration risk on KMS rotation and autoscale tuning)
- Renewal signal: Conditional positive if latency SLO met 85%+ and two critical blockers closed before 2026-04-15
- Current top blockers: KMS key rotation failure, burst autoscaling flapping on Dedicated pool, incomplete observability for token-level costs

Milestone tracker (concise rows for sync):
1) Production SLO validation (latency P50/P95 for 1M tokens/day)
   - Owner: Diego Morales
   - Due: 2026-03-22
   - Status: in_progress
   - Blockers: synthetic workload generator underestimates cold-starts (JIRA-ACME-1157)
   - Next steps: SRE to add cold-start scenarios, Solutions to provide representative prompt set by 2026-03-10

2) KMS rotation and HSM integration (customer-managed keys)
   - Owner: Priya Nair
   - Due: 2026-03-18 (soft) / 2026-04-01 (hard)
   - Status: at_risk
   - Blockers: rotation job fails during key rollover; failure mode causes inference errors (JIRA-ACME-1189)
   - Next steps: schedule joint debug session with Customer Security (2026-03-09), patch ready in branch kms-fix-03

3) Dedicated pool autoscale stabilization (burst capacity policy tuning)
   - Owner: Omar Singh
   - Due: 2026-03-29
   - Status: in_progress
   - Blockers: spike-driven scaling oscillation; requires guardrails in router policy; observed during customer load test 2026-03-04
   - Next steps: platform to deploy rate limiter and test with 2x spike profile by 2026-03-16

4) Token-level cost visibility & billing mapping (for renewal economics conversation)
   - Owner: Maya Chen
   - Due: 2026-03-12
   - Status: needs_attention
   - Blockers: mapping between route IDs and accounting codes incomplete; billing export missing embeddings breakdown
   - Next steps: Finance + Observability sync 2026-03-10 to scope export fields; create billing dashboard card

5) Runbooks and operational playbooks (failover, model rollback, cold-start mitigation)
   - Owner: Diego Morales
   - Due: 2026-03-20
   - Status: in_progress
   - Blockers: partial draft only; runbook validation not performed with SRE on-call
   - Next steps: schedule tabletop exercise 2026-03-19; capture results in Confluence page and link to linked_artifacts

Renewal-readiness signals (hard/soft gates):
- Hard gates (must meet before renewal negotiation):
  * Latency SLO: P95 <= customer SLA target for 14-day rolling window (owner: Diego Morales)
  * Critical blocker count = 0 (blockers marked "critical")
  * Billing exports include token-level breakdown for prior 30 days (owner: Maya Chen)

- Soft gates (strongly recommended):
  * Autoscale stability with 99% successful burst capacity activation (owner: Omar Singh)
  * KMS rotation validated in staging twice with no errors (owner: Priya Nair)
  * Runbooks signed off by Customer Ops (owner: Diego Morales)

Risk register (top 5):
- KMS rotation bug causes brief 5–10 minute inference failures during rollover — mitigation: emergency rollback and patch; severity: high
- Autoscale flapping under synthetic spikes causing request rejections — mitigation: router guardrails and rate limit; severity: medium-high
- Billing mapping mismatch delaying renewal economics discussion — mitigation: temporary manual export; severity: medium
- Incomplete tracing for embeddings requests preventing quality regressions detection — mitigation: add tracing span and sampling; severity: medium
- Customer internal SSO policy delays provisioning of test accounts — mitigation: escalate via CSM to customer IAM owner; severity: low

Escalation path and owners:
- Day-to-day owner for each milestone is listed in the milestone row.
- If a blocker remains unresolved 7 days past due, escalate to CS Director (Leah O'Connor) and Solutions Eng lead (Samir Patel) with the "blocker digest" email template.
- For security-impacting issues (KMS/HSM, network peering), immediately page security on-call and file an incident report in the security channel; tag the ticket with "security-impact".

Meeting cadence & artifacts:
- Weekly cross-functional sync: Tuesday 10am PT — update this doc before the meeting.
- Bi-weekly Renewal readiness review with Account Exec: Fridays 2pm PT.
- Attachments: sample prompts for SLO validation (link in linked_artifacts), autoscale load generator README, runbook draft link.

Action items (current):
- Priya: run kms-fix-03 in staging and validate key rollover 3x by 2026-03-12.
- Omar: deploy router guardrails to staging and run 2 spike tests; report results in sync 2026-03-16.
- Diego: finalize runbook and convene tabletop exercise 2026-03-19.
- Maya: produce billing delta export and create billing dashboard card by 2026-03-12.

Notes / Open questions (to be resolved in next sync):
- Should we offer a temporary SLA credit if KMS rotation is delayed past the hard gate? (Account Exec input required)
- Is customer willing to accept a fall-back model variant (smaller quantized model) for burst capacity if Dedicated pool cannot scale fast enough? (Cost/reliability tradeoff)

Appendix: quick links and templates
- Blocker digest email template: [template id JIRA-TEMP-02]
- Renewal one-pager template: Confluence link in linked_artifacts
- Test prompt set: github link in linked_artifacts

Change log:
- 2026-02-28: Initial draft created (Maya Chen)
- 2026-03-02: Added autoscale notes after load test (Omar Singh)
- 2026-03-08: Updated KMS status to at_risk after failed rotation test (Priya Nair)
